abstract.para: Network UPS Tools (NUT) is an open source software suite that provides support for power devices, such as Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), power distribution units and controllers. It simplifies the process of monitoring power hardware and ensures orderly system shutdowns during power outages.

topic.para: The NUT packages follow the stable lifecycle model. NUT packages are updated and supported according to the following rules:

listitem.para: NUT is categorized under the stable lifecycle because newer upstream versions maintain strict backward compatibility. This ensures that upgrades do not introduce disruptive changes or affect existing system stability for customers on any &suselinux; 16 minor version.

Because upstream versions are backward compatible, updates are primarily driven by the introduction of new features that are difficult or impractical to backport. The primary goal of these upgrades is to deliver new hardware support (such as compatibility with new UPS models) and capabilities to customers.
When a new version with valuable features is available upstream, the packages are updated across all supported codestreams in general support and maintenance.

Since the upstream release schedule does not follow a regular pattern, new version submissions are permitted as they are released upstream. These updates can be delivered either within a new &suselinux; minor release or directly as part of maintenance updates for already released codestreams.
